subject: Signing authority matrix + Exhibit ownership — MSA & Order Form intake
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@kelvinbiotech.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Signing authority matrix + exhibit owners (MSA / Order Form) — intake

Hi Aisha — great to connect yesterday. As discussed, we want to make the contracting kickoff as smooth as possible. To help legal and procurement move quickly, can you send the following by end of day Wednesday?

- Primary signing authority (name, title, email) for the MSA
- Back-up signer and any delegated signing limits (e.g., up to $50k)
- Exhibit ownership: which internal Kelvin teams own each Exhibit (Billing, Data Processing, SOW, Security Annex)
- Primary billing contact and PO process (email + billing address)
- Any residency / tax residency notes (US / EEA / APAC) that would affect where data or invoices should be routed

I attached our intake worksheet — filling the first tab (party & signer matrix) will let Kimberly and Marissa start the initial redline pass and surface any scope flags. If you prefer a short 20-minute sync instead of filling the sheet, happy to schedule.

Attachments: msa_orderform_intake_template.xlsx (worksheet)

Thanks — I’ll loop in Rishi from contracting after we have the signer info so we can lock a timeline.

—Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0147

Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Signing authority matrix + exhibit owners (MSA / Order Form) — intake

Hi Mateo — thanks for the clear checklist. See answers below and attached signer list.

- Primary signer: Luke Harrington (Head of Ops) — luke.h@kelvinbiotech.com
- Backup: Tara Singh (Finance Manager) — tara.singh@kelvinbiotech.com; delegated limit = $75,000
- Exhibit ownership:
  * Billing: Finance (Tara Singh)
  * Data Processing & Security Annex: IT Security (Rajesh Patel)
  * SOW/Professional Services Exhibit: Product (Aminah Torres)
- Billing contact: invoices@kelvinbiotech.com; Billing address: 410 Market St, Suite 220, San Francisco, CA 94105
- Residency/tax: Kelvin Biotech is US-headquartered. We have an EU subsidiary (Kelvin Biotech EU Ltd) that handles some EEA data projects; for now, this engagement will be US-only. If Redwood needs EEA residency language later we can coordinate.

Attachment: kelvin_signer_list.pdf

Quick Q: on the Order Form, do you have a preferred way to capture reseller vs direct billing? We sometimes need an addendum for tax handling.

If helpful I can set a 20-min slot Tuesday afternoon to walk through.

Best,
Aisha Malik
Procurement Operations | Kelvin Biotech
aisha.malik@kelvinbiotech.com | +1 617-555-0223
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@kelvinbiotech.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 12:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Signing authority matrix + exhibit owners (MSA / Order Form) — intake

Thanks Aisha — helpful detail and thanks for the PDF. A few immediate notes from legal after a quick scan: 

- Signers: Luke as primary + Tara as backup looks fine. We’ll confirm that the delegated $75k threshold is reflected in the signatory block/Order Form.
- Exhibits: please confirm the contact emails for Rajesh (security) and Aminah (product) so we can add them to the exhibit owners field in the intake sheet — that allows us to route any technical security questionnaires directly.
- Residency/tax: since this engagement is US-only for now, we won’t require EEA-specific data residency language. If Kelvin later requests EEA residency we’ll coordinate with you on the right routing to our Private deployment or EU-region terms.

Action items for us (from legal):
- I’ll run an initial redline focusing on: liability caps, data processing exhibits, and signatory language.
- Marissa will map billing/contact clauses to the Order Form and confirm PO flow for invoicing (particularly whether invoices go to invoices@kelvinbiotech.com or to the AP portal).

Aisha — could you confirm the AP portal URL (if any) and whether a PO number will be supplied on each invoice? That affects invoice remittance routing.

Thanks — I’ll aim to deliver a first-pass redline by EOD Wednesday.

—Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Thanks all — good progress. Quick coordination: 

- Kimberly: please mark priority items in the redline ("Must resolve before signature" vs "Operational ok for later") so Sales can set expectations.
- Marissa: confirm invoicing flow and whether Kelvin needs a billing contact on the Order Form aside from the invoice email.
- Mateo: I’ll schedule a 30-minute kickoff Tue 10:30am PT with Aisha + their security lead (Rajesh) and include a short agenda: 1) signers & PO flow, 2) exhibit ownership handoff, 3) timeline for redline completion. If that time doesn't work for Kelvin, tell me preferred windows.

Rishi
